title: SpendRecord
description: The model calls, tokens, cost, wall time and llm steps one source attributes to one task.

artifact.description: The artifact the spend is attributed to.

source.description: The one source every figure of this record is read from.

source_digest.description: `sha256:` and the SHA-256 of the source's bytes as read, as aep.evidence.InputDigest says.

source_input.description: The source, named as aep.evidence.InputForm `repository_relative` after every link in its path and in the root's is resolved, so it names the file whose bytes were read; never a file name alone and never an absolute path.

model_calls.description: Distinct API requests the transcript records (`Census::api_requests`, `api_request_count` in ir.rs). Absent when the source records none.

thinking_tokens.description: Billed thinking tokens the API reported (`RunUsage::thinking_tokens`).

total_tokens.description: The total the source states (an `eval.run-manifest/1`'s `tokens`), or, for a transcript or a driven run, the sum of input, output, cache read and cache write tokens when all four are known and the sum fits; otherwise absent. Thinking tokens are their own figure and are not part of it.

cost_micro_usd.description: What the task cost, in millionths of a US dollar, as the transcript (`RunOutcome::total_cost_usd`) or the run manifest (`cost_micro_usd`) states it.

wall_time_ms.description: Wall-clock duration in milliseconds (`RunOutcome::duration_ms`, the manifest's `wall_time_ms`).

llm_steps_declared.description: For a driven run, how many llm steps its step map declares; absent for any other source.

llm_steps_run.description: For a driven run, how many llm steps it ran; absent for any other source.
